purpose: Test whether the bounded reuse conclusions retain nontrivial structure under an independently motivated, deliberately lossy process-graph representation rather than an invertible tagged recoding.
motivation: A generic process-model view that tracks carriers/components, guards/goals, interfaces, transformations, and temporal ordering while intentionally discarding the finer epistemic role distinctions used by the working basis.

coarse_families.N: carrier/component node; merges S/X-like state/structure and Pi boundary/partition
coarse_families.G: guard/orientation; merges C constraint and Q criterion
coarse_families.I: interface event; merges P probe/intervention and O/rho observation/readout
coarse_families.E: transformation/dependence edge; absorbs K and collapses non-temporal relation labels
coarse_families.T: temporal presence/order; collapses detailed temporal subtypes

canonicalization: Map every active axis and node axis through axis_map; node role strings and historical labels are discarded.
Represent node content only by the multiset of coarse family counts.
Map every non-temporal structural edge to E while retaining arity and ordered-versus-unordered status; discard original edge family/kind names.
Map any temporal-order edge or any present temporal metadata to T; retain only temporal presence plus the number of explicitly temporal edges, not temporal subtype names.
Discard working-basis control subtype names (partition_Pi, criterion_Q, probe_P, and analogous tags).
Sort the resulting coarse signature canonically and group original archetypes by exact coarse-signature equality.
deliberate_information_loss: non-temporal relation-family and relation-kind distinctions are not recoverable.
temporal subtype distinctions such as persistence, recurrence, horizon, and history-window are not recoverable.
predeclared_outputs: prove the mapping is non-injective by exhibiting at least one collision among original role/axis distinctions and, if present, among original 206 archetypes
number of distinct CPCG signatures induced by the 206 frozen bounded objects
number of CPCG signatures with support from more than one sampling lane
number and proportion of the original 99 cross-lane bounded families that collapse with another family under CPCG
number of corpus claims supported by at least one cross-lane CPCG signature
whether the frozen ATT01-BLF01 cross-label bounded-reuse witness remains shared after CPCG projection
no_pass_threshold: No retention threshold is declared. The result is descriptive sensitivity: survival, collapse, or failure are all reportable outcomes.
forbidden_claims: survival under CPCG proves natural-kind identity.
failure under CPCG refutes the working basis.
this single lossy rival exhausts plausible alternative representations.

prefreeze_disclosure.consequence: Same-label examples are expository post hoc witnesses and are not counted as blinded CPCG tests.
